p:
Lingyi iTECH was founded in 2006. It listed on the A-share market in 2018, and on June 26, 2026 it began trading on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange Main Board (1688.HK), with a market capitalization above 100 billion yuan. As a trusted core supplier of AI terminal hardware, Lingyi iTECH provides one-stop intelligent manufacturing services and solutions worldwide for its customers, including precision functional parts, structural parts, and modules.
In robot OEM and assembly, we have large-scale mass-production capability. To date, the company has completed hardware and whole-machine assembly services for nearly 10,000 humanoid (embodied) robots for leading robotics companies. The scope covers the full manufacturing chain: final assembly, dexterous hand assembly, joint modules, and high-precision components for the head, waist, arms, and legs. Backed by five embodied-AI manufacturing bases in Dongguan, Zhengzhou, Chengdu, Beijing, and overseas, we offer precision structural part machining across all major processes, including CNC, die casting, MIM, and 3D printing, along with whole-machine ODM services. On the deployment side, we have independently developed wheeled-chassis robots for factory material handling and sorting: Linglong, Panshi, and Lingyue. These products use real-time LiDAR localization and coordinated dual-arm planning to achieve autonomous obstacle avoidance, in-place rotation, and millimeter-level material pick-and-place in narrow aisles or open areas, directly supporting automated production-line logistics. We believe the CHTF Robot Expo is the best venue to show Lingyi's full-stack capability, from core components to hardware manufacturing to real-world deployment, and we look forward to exploring with industry partners the practical paths to robot mass production and factory application.

领益智造成立于2006年，2018年登陆A股资本市场，2026年6月26日在香港联交所主板挂牌上市（1688.HK），市值超1000亿。作为值得信赖的AI终端硬件核心供应商，领益智造在全球范围内为客户提供精密功能件、结构件、模组等一站式智能制造服务及解决方案。
在机器人OEM与组装领域，我们具备大规模量产交付能力。截至目前，公司给头部机器人公司完成近万台人形（具身）机器人硬件及整机组装服务，覆盖整机装配、灵巧手组装、关节模组及头、腰、臂、腿等高精度部件的全链条制造。依托东莞、郑州、成都、北京及海外五大具身智能制造基地，我们可为客户提供CNC、压铸、MIM、3D打印等全工艺精密结构件加工与整机ODM服务。在场景落地端，我们针对工厂物料搬运与整理场景自研轮式底盘机器人玲珑、磐石、领跃。该产品通过激光雷达实时定位与双臂协同规划，可在狭窄通道或空旷区域实现自主避障、原地自转与毫米级物料取放，直接服务于产线物流自动化。我们相信，高交会机器人展是展示领益“核心部件—硬件制造—场景落地”全栈能力的最佳窗口，期待与业界伙伴共探机器人量产化与工厂应用的真实路径。
